notes: Large-source-unit 21 (יִּיטַב לִפְנֵי → *it pleased*) retained: the verb, preposition and construct noun are contiguous and the single rendering carries all three, exactly as `רַע בְּעֵינֵי` → *it displease* under rule 40; *the king* keeps its own words. עַד־מָתַי → *For how long* stays noncompositional (rule 17).
